scope: Actual original PIE world and BT_NPC. Observe native path following, world ticks, coordinates, and completion callbacks. Follow target is a player teleport fixture on a verified reachable path. Home arrival uses a nearby projected home fixture; it is not proof that the authored home destination is reachable.
isolation: Fresh dedicated PIE ends after this suite. Reflected fixture fields and actor transforms are restored before EndPIE; input focus, BT history, native latent tasks, and exact timing state are not claimed generally reversible. No assets or navigation settings are saved or modified.

authored_speed_oracle.source: Actual loaded BT_NPC RootNode -> Children.ChildComposite/ChildTask traversal. Blueprint task class defaults can differ from authored task-instance overrides; expected values come from the tree instance, not the CDO or movement observation.

original_home_query.oracle: Original DT_NPC_Data NPC_01 Home_Location; query only, not an arrival test.

stages.oracle: Actual original BT_NPC running at time600, no follow/interaction/home flag. Require >=2 game seconds, >=75 unit displacement, moving valid path away from authored home, and the authored BT_NPC patrol-task instance speed. No harness NPC MoveTo is issued.

Original Follow input at NPC_01 threshold80, original BT chase, real world-tick movement; require >=200 unit gap reduction, >=75 unit NPC displacement, observed moving path ending near the player, authored BT_NPC chase-task instance speed, and actor/BB follow state.
stages.target_setup: Player TeleportTo collision-checked near a navigation-projected point; no NPC movement command is issued by the harness.

stages.oracle: Original scheduled off-work ReceiveTick -> original AI MoveTo -> actual Success callback -> original actor hide/collision-off branch. Require >=100 unit displacement and <=50 unit final 2D distance; original MoveTo acceptance radius is10 and no harness hide or NPC MoveTo is used.
stages.fixture_scope: My_NPC_Data.Home_Location is temporarily replaced by a verified reachable nearby point. Authored home validity is separately queried and not inferred from this fixture.
